calculation.description: Ranks assets by 20-day momentum normalized by realized 20-day volatility and weighted toward price paths with a higher fraction of positive sessions. The signal uses data through t and is applied only after t, avoiding look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 20-day IC/ICIR were 0.097845/0.308988 in 2020-2022, 0.067148/0.197670 in 2023-2025, -0.044006/-0.117035 in 2026-2027, and -0.026308/-0.071823 in 2028-2030. The full-sample gate passes, but recent momentum reversal/drift is material and requires monitoring or regime conditioning.
validation.methodology: Cross-sectional Pearson IC between signal at date t and cumulative forward log return over the next h trading sessions; each date requires at least 8 valid instruments; 15-instrument benchmark universe used.
